question_text: Was the Atlassian Bitbucket and login outage on Nov 23 a hack?
answer_text: Not established. Atlassian says it found the cause and applied a fix, and services are recovering, but it has not said what the cause is. No one has claimed an attack and we found no report calling it one; no source has ruled one out.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: An Atlassian post-incident report giving the cause, or a statement from a security authority or an outside investigator.

question_text: What caused the Bitbucket and Atlassian sign-in outage?
what_would_settle_it: An Atlassian post-incident report or other statement naming the cause.

answer_text: On Bitbucket, sign-in and Pipelines are partial outages; the website, API and Git access showed operational. The same sign-in incident is posted for Jira, Jira Service Management, Trello and Atlassian's developer platform.
label: Confirmed

what_would_settle_it: Atlassian marking the incident resolved on its status pages. At 12:36 PM ET it had applied a fix and was monitoring recovery.
